description: This file is a markdown source document describing the 'Frame' class in the Playwright API, including its lifecycle, methods, events, and usage examples across multiple programming languages. It contains detailed documentation, code snippets, and method signatures related to the Frame object, indicating it is a source documentation file for the API.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a frame within a page, providing methods to interact with and inspect the frame's content, navigation, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: childFrames
methods.description: Returns an array of all child frames of this frame.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Gets the full HTML contents of the frame, including the doctype.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event on the element matching the selector.

methods.name: dragAndDrop
methods.description: Performs a drag and drop operation from source to target element.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Finds an element matching the selector within the frame and evaluates a script on it.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Finds all elements matching the selector within the frame and evaluates a script on them.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script in the context of the frame.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a script and returns a JSHandle for the result.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a form element with the provided value.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Returns the `frame` or `iframe` element handle which corresponds to this frame.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a frame locator to interact with the iframe contents.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute value of the element matching the selector.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified placeholder text.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified role.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified test id.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) containing specified text.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a Locator targeting element(s) with specified title text.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to the specified URL.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over an element matching the selector.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML of the element matching the selector.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Returns the inner text of the element matching the selector.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the input or textarea element matching the selector.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns whether a checkbox or radio element is checked.

methods.name: isDetached
methods.description: Returns true if the frame has been detached.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Returns whether the element matching the selector is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Returns whether the element matching the selector is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the element matching the selector is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Returns whether the element matching the selector is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the element matching the selector is visible.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a locator to interact with elements in the frame.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the frame.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page that contains this frame.

methods.name: parentFrame
methods.description: Returns the parent frame if any, or null if this is the main frame.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key in the frame.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Returns an ElementHandle for the first element matching the selector.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Returns ElementHandle objects for all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a <select> element.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Checks or unchecks an element.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the page content via document.write call.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files in an input[type=file] element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Taps an element matching the selector.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Returns the textContent of the element matching the selector.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the page title.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into an element matching the selector.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox or radio input.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the frame's URL.

methods.name: waitForFunction
methods.description: Waits for a function to return a truthy value.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the frame's load state.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for the given timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a specific URL.
